learnings: `pyproject.toml` holds PEP 621 metadata; the build backend (hatchling, setuptools, poetry-core) is just a pluggable implementation.
A wheel is a zip of code plus `*.dist-info` metadata; `py3-none-any` means one wheel for every platform.
`twine check` and a TestPyPI upload rehearse a release safely; tokens belong in environment variables or CI secrets.
pitfalls: `python -m build` normally downloads the backend; `--no-isolation` uses the installed one so builds work offline in CI.
